info.title: Devops-Glue API
info.description: DevOps toolchain integration API — unified interface for Jenkins / GitLab CI, GitLab / Gitee / GitHub / Gitea, and Harbor.

tags.name: RBAC
tags.description: Role & Permission Management (data-driven; includes permission registration, implied rules, role CRUD)

git.description: null means no Git platform configured

harbor_components.description: Harbor sub-component health (core/jobservice/registry; any false makes overall harbor false)

job_name.description: Jenkins Job full path / GitLab CI project path

MapGroupedResult.description: Mapping relationships grouped by project path

all.description: Returns all pipeline→tag mappings for this project when pipeline is omitted

source.description: Config source: database=UI or DB setting, env=.env fallback

oneOf.description: Permission key list for current role

BuildModeResult.description: Build mode and actual Provider availability

has_jenkins.description: Whether Jenkins has a usable base URL configured

has_gitlab_ci.description: Whether GitLab CI has usable base_url + token

role.description: Associated role name, foreign key to roles.name

is_root.description: Whether this is the built-in root account from .env ADMIN_USER; root cannot be deleted

name.description: Unique role name, referenced as foreign key by admin_users.role

is_system.description: Built-in system role; built-in roles cannot be deleted or have permissions modified

permissions.description: Expanded permission keys owned by this role (implied rules already resolved)

PermissionEntry.description: Permission definition (data-driven, can be registered by CD projects via API)

parent_key.description: Parent permission key for hierarchical menu display

created_at.description: Registered at; null for built-in permissions

is_builtin.description: Whether this is a built-in permission (built-in cannot be deleted)

ImpliedRule.description: Permission implication: having source_key automatically grants target_key

builtin_implied.description: Built-in implication map (seed data, non-deletable): source_key → [target_key,...]; used by the frontend to distinguish built-in vs user-added rules

ApiTokenEntry.description: API token entry (no plaintext; plaintext is returned only once at creation)

token.description: One-time plaintext token (dg_ prefix + 64 hex chars), returned only once

get.description: Check Jenkins, Git platform, and Harbor connectivity. Returns 200 if all healthy, 503 if partially degraded.
Fetches from Jenkins in real-time when in jenkins mode, or from DB in gitlab_ci mode. Falls back to DB cache if Jenkins is unreachable.
Returns mapping relationships grouped by project. 30s cache in jenkins mode.
Returns statically configured Git platform info and Harbor API info.
Compares Git platforms used in mappings against configured platforms, returning configured and unconfigured lists.
Returns all active mapped jobs with ci_provider, project_id, current_path. ?format=raw returns plain job name array.

200.description: raw format returns job name array; json format returns objects with provider info

get.description: Returns the currently effective build mode and its source. Database is the single source of truth; first run seeds from .env.
Unified query for Jenkins / GitLab CI pipelines. ?list=id returns ID array, ?list=success returns successful pipeline IDs.

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: id=ID array, build=with # prefix, time=with timestamp, success=successful only

get.description: ?format=raw returns plain status array (e.g. ["success", "failed"])

post.description: Pass parameters in POST body JSON via variables=object (recommended). Root-level keys are also accepted (legacy compat). Parameter names must match Jenkins Job definitions; call GET /api/build/{path}/variables first to discover them.

ref.description: Branch name (passthrough; required for GitLab CI mode)

variables.description: Build parameters (keys must match Job definitions)

get.description: Legacy compat mode: parameters passed via Query String. ref is only used in GitLab CI mode.
Returns Jenkins Job parameter definitions or GitLab CI variables. ?format=json returns full object with build_provider; default returns simplified {key: options}.
Returns plain string array, usable directly as Rundeck Option Model Provider remote URL.

post.summary: Harbor image scan → Commit Status write-back
post.description: Call after CI pipeline build completion. Automatically fetches Harbor vulnerability report and writes result back to Git platform commit status (harbor-scan context). If tag is omitted, uses the latest from Harbor.

tag.description: Image tag; omits to use latest from Harbor

post.summary: Generic security scan Commit Status write-back
post.description: Similar to GitHub Actions Security Check. Results from any security scanner (SAST, secret scan, dependency vuln, IaC audit, etc.) can be written back to the Git platform commit/MR page. Audit records are automatically written to ci_security_checks table.

get.description: ?pipeline=52 queries tag for a specific pipeline; omit to return all mappings for this project. ?format=raw returns 'repo:tag' format.

get.summary: List Git branches for a Job

get.description: Repository names containing / require double-encoding (%2F).
Returns vulnerability list. Harbor v2 returns structured data, v1 returns raw report. Empty array when no vulnerabilities.

200.description: Vulnerability report array, empty when clean

post.description: Returns Bearer token (24h expiry). Checks database bcrypt password first, falls back to .env when DB is unavailable.

put.description: Requires old password verification. Clears all old tokens upon change, forcing re-login. New password must be at least 8 characters.

post.description: Scans all Jenkins Jobs, matches Git platform via git remote, returns newly discovered entries and writes them to mapping table. Returns 503 if Jenkins is unavailable.

get.description: Paginated query of ci_security_checks table. Supports filtering by project, check_type, state.

get.summary: Get platform API versions and config status
get.description: Returns version numbers, sources (config/json/default), and whether each platform is configured.

put.description: Pass {versions: {gitlab: 'v5', harbor: 'v2.0'}}. Values matching defaults are not persisted.

get.description: Query current user's role and permissions using Bearer token. Only requires a valid token, does not need admin privileges. super_admin role returns "*" wildcard.

get.summary: List all permissions and implication rules
get.description: Returns all registered permission definitions (with parent_key hierarchy) and the permission implication map. Permissions are data-driven and can be registered by CD projects via the POST endpoint.

post.description: Register a new permission key for menu visibility and hasPermission checks. super_admin only; typically auto-registered by CD projects rather than manually. description is required (used as i18n fallback).

parent_key.description: Parent permission key for hierarchical menu

delete.description: Delete the specified permission key, cascading cleanup of role_permissions and implied_rules associations. super_admin only. Built-in permissions (keys in AppConfig::DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS) are protected and cannot be deleted.

post.description: Register a permission implication: having source_key automatically grants target_key. super_admin only. Both source_key and target_key must already exist in the permissions table.

delete.description: Delete a permission implication rule. super_admin only.

post.description: Delete the current Bearer token from the cache table so it is rejected on subsequent requests. Returns success even if no valid token is provided.

get.summary: Get build mode and Provider availability
get.description: Returns the currently active build mode (jenkins/gitlab_ci/both), where the mode came from, and whether the Jenkins / GitLab CI providers are actually configured and usable.

put.description: Switch the global build mode. When switching to a single provider, active job mappings of the other provider are automatically downgraded to pending to prevent unexpected participation. The target provider must be configured and available; otherwise the switch is rejected.

get.description: admin and above see all users; regular roles cannot see admin/super_admin users. Response does not include password hashes.

post.description: Create a new admin user. ci.users.manage_admin permission is required to create admin/super_admin roles. Users created by non-admins may not have systems containing ci. Password must be at least 8 characters.

password.description: Plain-text password, stored as bcrypt hash

403.description: Forbidden: promoting to admin without manage_admin perm, or assigning ci to non-admin creator

put.description: Only provided fields are updated: password is changed if non-empty; role is changed if provided. Modifying or promoting to admin/super_admin requires ci.users.manage_admin. password min length is 8.

password.description: New password (plaintext, optional; empty means do not change)

role.description: New role name (optional, omitted means do not change)

403.description: Forbidden: editing admin or promoting without sufficient permission

delete.description: Delete the specified admin user. Restrictions: 1) Root account (.env ADMIN_USER) cannot be deleted by anyone; 2) Cannot delete yourself; 3) Deleting admin/super_admin role users requires ci.users.manage_admin permission.

get.summary: List all roles and their permissions
get.description: Returns the role list; each role includes the expanded permission key array. is_system=true means a built-in role that cannot be deleted or have its permissions changed.

post.description: Create a custom role. Only users with ci.users.manage_admin permission can create. When permissions are provided, the backend auto-expands implied rules and keeps only keys already defined in the permissions table. is_system is always 0 (not built-in).

permissions.description: Permission key array (no need to pass implied ones; backend expands automatically)

put.summary: Update role (name / description / permissions, full replace)
put.description: ci.users.manage_admin permission only. Only custom roles (is_system=0) can be modified. When name changes, admin_users.role rows referencing the old name are cascaded. If the permissions key is present (even empty array), the role's permissions are fully replaced with the new set after auto-expanding implied rules.

name.description: New name (optional, must be unique; change cascades to user role references)

permissions.description: Permission keys (presence of this key triggers full replace; empty array clears all permissions)

403.description: Not ci.users.manage_admin or modifying built-in role

409.description: New name collides with another role

delete.description: ci.users.manage_admin permission only. Only custom roles (is_system=0) can be deleted. If any user still references the role, the request is rejected with 400 role.in_use. Deletion cascades and cleans up role_permissions links.

403.description: Not ci.users.manage_admin or deleting built-in role

get.description: Returns the selectable scope list (for UI rendering). Super admin only.
Returns the token list (no plaintext). Super admin only.

post.description: Creates a token and returns one-time plaintext (shown only once). Super admin only.

post.summary: Revoke an API token (disable, keep record)
post.description: Disables the token (enabled=0), immediately invalid but keeps the record. Super admin only.

delete.description: Hard deletes the token record. Super admin only.
